title: Beneath a Crimson Sky
user_request: so can we rebuild the original artwork, at 4k and ensure AAA levels of realism and detail?

successes: Broader coherent cliff strata and natural fracture planes replace the melted lattice of v11
Foreground stone has quieter faces and more credible block/joint construction
Bridge arches and principal monastery masses read as supported construction
Original bench, blanket, barrel, lantern, roof framing and sheltered terrace remain
Rocky world is unobscured within a luminous clear red-orange opening
limitations: Fresh reconstruction changes the detailed fortress design, dome placement and some terrain contours; not pixel-preserved v7/v11 geometry
World appears a little higher and slightly smaller than v11, while retaining the requested larger-than-original scale
Some foreground tooling/roughness remains; AAA is an art-direction target, not a verified production certification
Generated image is 1672x941; the 3840x2160 file is upscaled and contains no extra detail from resampling

export.method: Pillow ImageOps.fit Lanczos, centred aspect-preserving crop, no sharpening
export.detail_provenance: Source materials and geometry freshly generated from original terrace reference; 4K file is a deterministic enlargement of that rebuilt image, not the rejected v11.

animation: Existing animation-v1 uses v11; no source substitution or mask reuse. Any future animation must freeze this new source and remap geometry.
backup: Local uncommitted production; prior art backup does not cover this rebuild.
